scope: Public component code and dated public descriptions only. Not a whole-product completion score or a live development tracker.

families.name: Evidence & custody
families.summary: Retain captured inputs, canonical records and a hash-linked history in the offline demo.
families.boundary: Logical checks in one process. No independent custody, signing, source-truth guarantee or full native runtime is demonstrated.

families.name: Controls & authority
families.summary: Logical authority checks and the bounded UCC plan engine are public. UCC runs declared predicates over supplied data and retains PASS, FAIL, HOLD and NOT_EXECUTED distinctions.
families.boundary: Supplied-field checks do not establish source truth or professional compliance. Human procedures remain unexecuted; no operating-system enforcement or installed integration is claimed here.

families.name: Review & correction
families.summary: Scripted review decisions, a separate repair child, export/reopen and one interrupted-decision recovery are exercised by the demo.
families.boundary: The human decisions are scripted; the original findings remain. This is not actual human acceptance, learned improvement or a professional conclusion.

families.name: Grounding & analysis
families.summary: Full CoherenceLattice grounding and claim/evidence relationships remain development components. The separate bounded UCC predicate engine is now public under Controls & authority.
families.boundary: This map does not qualify full CoherenceLattice execution or current installed integration. UCC predicates over supplied fields are narrower than source-grounded cognitive analysis.

families.name: Evaluation & posture
families.summary: Sophia evaluation and Atlas explanation have distinct responsibilities in the broader development architecture.
families.boundary: Named records in this demo do not prove those components ran. Agreement alone is not independent corroboration; no current whole-system pass is claimed.

families.name: Workbench & providers
families.summary: Control Anchor interfaces, authenticated task intake, provider selection and retained outcomes are described in dated development checkpoints.
families.boundary: Source, injected-boundary tests and hosted installation evidence have different scopes. No installer, live model invocation or current installed acceptance is supplied by this map.

families.name: Continuity & memory
families.summary: Eligible retrieval, purpose-limited reuse and restart-aware continuity are design goals. Existing retained history is a foundation, not proof of this broader capability.
families.boundary: Optional memory and adaptive reuse require their own implementation and evidence. Retention is not training consent; a successor must not inherit unearned authority.

families.name: Community compute
families.summary: Voluntary, locally governed Sophia cooperation is the network vision. Dated bounded peer experiments are groundwork, not an operating shared-compute service.
families.boundary: Distributed execution, independent participants and practical usefulness remain separate proof obligations. This public demo performs no networked compute.

families.name: Learning & research
families.summary: Adaptive attention, analogy, recursive review and measurement proposals are research directions, not established improvements.
families.boundary: No general learning, consciousness, speed, cost or scientific benefit is established by design descriptions or test totals. Negative and unknown findings remain relevant.
